policy.intent: Provide an installable VELA runtime for Codex-based research workflows.
include: literature acquisition and citation evidence workflows
writing, review, figure, presentation, submission, and quantitative workflows
Python requirements and toolchain manifests without vendored runtime binaries
validators, envctl modules, scripts, schemas, and tests
exclude: browser login state, cookies, credentials, and personal secrets

layout.runtime_mode: installable through `vela runtime enable --include core,automation,toolchain --commit`; not automatically copied by `vela init`
